component.name: QuickShot
component.summary: Fast GTK 4 Screenshot & Annotation Tool for Linux

description.p: QuickShot is a lightweight, native Rust and GTK 4 screenshot capture and instant annotation tool for Linux desktops.

ul.li: Full-screen and interactive region capture via XDG Desktop Portal with optional 0s / 3s / 5s delay
Fast built-in Cairo annotation tools: Arrow, Rectangle, Privacy Blur/Pixelate, and Crop with Undo
One-click copy to clipboard (Ctrl+C) and PNG export (Ctrl+S) with full Hebrew keyboard shortcut support

description.p: Initial Flatpak release of QuickShot with XDG Desktop Portal capture, Cairo annotation tools, crop, blur, and clipboard export.
